Ignacio Rodriguez
Málaga, Spain  |  [redacted-phone]  |  [redacted-email]  |  [redacted-linkedin]

Backend / Full Stack Developer with over 4 years of professional experience developing backend services, APIs, 
internal platforms, dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, automation workflows, and production systems across 
EdTech, energy, telecommunications, logistics, fintech-related projects, and international environments.
Strong background in Python, Flask, Django, FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, AWS, PHP, 
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, CI/CD, reporting platforms, and business-oriented software solutions.
Experienced building software that automates manual processes, transforms business data into useful workflows, 
integrates multiple systems through APIs, and supports internal teams with reliable SaaS-like products. Practical 
interest in AI-powered automation, LLM API integrations, prototyping, and turning ideas into production-ready tools.

Fiction Express Málaga, Spain
Backend Developer working on analytics, product metrics, internal APIs, and user activity data systems for an EdTech 
SaaS platform used by students, teachers, and education teams.
• Developed backend services in Python for analytics, reporting, user activity tracking, and product metrics.
• Built data pipelines to record reading activity from thousands of students and classrooms.
• Developed backend workflows to transform user activity events into engagement, progress, and product usage 
metrics.
• Worked with APIs, data models, and internal systems used by product and education teams.
• Improved analytics infrastructure to strengthen traceability, scalability, maintainability, and data reliability.
• Collaborated directly with product managers and stakeholders to define technical and functional requirements.

• Supported product development by turning business needs into backend features and production-ready

• Technologies: Python, Django, REST APIs, SQL, MongoDB, Docker, Redis, AWS, data pipelines, reporting,

Full Stack Developer October 2022 – April 2025
Talan Consulting Client: Cepsa · Málaga, Spain
Full Stack Developer working on backend services, automation tools, financial dashboards, market data tools, and 
reporting platforms for Cepsa, supporting finance, logistics, and operations teams.
• Developed backend services in Python and internal tools to support financial and operational decision-making.
• Built and maintained dashboards for finance teams, enabling visualization of business, operational, and market 
metrics.
• Developed reporting tools connected to gas and oil market values, supporting price evolution analysis and 
business impact assessment.
• Contributed to predictive tools and internal models related to gas and oil market behavior, helping anticipate 
trends and compare scenarios.
• Designed SQL queries, data flows, and backend integrations to transform operational and financial data into 
clear business metrics.
• Developed APIs and backend logic to connect internal data sources, reporting systems, and dashboard 
interfaces.
• Automated manual reporting and data-processing workflows for business users.
• Built frontend features with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript for business-oriented internal tools.
• Worked on existing applications, performing maintenance, debugging, refactoring, and continuous 
improvement.
• Collaborated directly with finance, operations, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and turn 
them into technical solutions.
• Presented dashboards, metrics, and technical insights to non-technical users.
• Identified improvements in performance, data quality, usability, automation, and maintainability across internal 
platforms.
• Worked in Agile/Scrum teams using Git, Docker, and collaborative delivery workflows.
• Technologies: Python, Flask, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, MySQL, Docker, Redis, Git, REST APIs, 
Power BI, dashboards, reporting platforms, financial tools, market data, predictive tools.
Backend Developer August 2022 – October 2022
Globant Client: Tigo LATAM · Buenos Aires, Argentina
Backend Developer contributing to an AWS-based microservices architecture for Tigo Telecommunications, 
supporting the processing of business and user data across Latin America.
• Developed and optimized backend services for large-scale data processing.
• Contributed to the design of services within a distributed microservices architecture.
• Worked in AWS cloud environments with a focus on scalability, reliability, and service communication.
• Collaborated with distributed engineering teams in an international environment.
• Supported backend systems managing business and user data across different markets.
• Worked with REST APIs, backend services, distributed systems, and cloud-based development practices.
• Technologies: Python, AWS, microservices, REST APIs, backend services, distributed systems, cloud 
environments.
Full Stack Developer November 2021 – August 2022
Balloon Group Buenos Aires, Argentina
Full Stack Developer developing web applications and backend services for international clients, including Toyota, 
Abbott, and Citelis.
• Developed web applications and backend services based on client requirements.
• Built a vehicle rental management platform used across multiple cities in Puerto Rico.
• Designed backend services, database structures, and business logic.
• Developed frontend and backend features for end users.
• Integrated APIs, persistence layers, and business workflows.
• Worked on international projects with varied functional and technical requirements.
• Used Python, PHP, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, backend services, and frontend development to deliver client-facing 
web applications.

Dear Hiring Team at PSS Tecnologías de la Información,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the AWS Backend / Cloud Developer position, as advertised. With over 4 years of experience in backend development and a strong background in AWS, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's efforts in building robust, scalable, and automated solutions.

My experience with Python, coupled with my knowledge of cloud-native services, positions me well to adapt to your tech stack. Although I have not worked directly with Terraform/AWS CDK/CloudFormation or explicit serverless architectures, my proficiency in AWS and backend development, along with my ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies, makes me an ideal candidate for this role.

I have attached my CV, which has been tailored to highlight my relevant skills and experience. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support your project's goals and how I can grow with your team.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to PSS Tecnologías de la Información.

Best Regards,
Ignacio Rodriguez
